item.title: LightFlow Optics: A new lab startup for web-based optical circuit design
item.description: LightFlow Optics, co-founded in 2024 by Sainath Motlakunta, Chung-You (Gilbert) Shih, and Prof. Rajibul Islam, is building a cloud-based platform to design, visualize, and fabricate optical circuits with faster iteration and streamlined handoff to manufacturing.
